snippet.title: GrooveKeeper: Sort the Record Shop - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Groovekeeper: Sort the Record Shop is a cozy first-person game about one perfect job, sorting a record shop's vinyl onto the shelves.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4953280

No customers. No timer. No fail state. Just you, the crates, and a shop that slowly turns from chaos into a perfectly sorted wall of records. Pick a crate, learn the shelves, and watch the mess become something clean and complete.

What to expect:
- Sort an entire record shop by genre, at your own pace
- A pure, no-pressure cozy loop with no way to lose
- A messy shop transformed shelf by shelf into a satisfying before and after
- Records to find, sort, and put on display

Wishlisting on Steam is the single biggest way to help a tiny studio like ours, and it makes sure you hear the moment the game is out.

Steam (Wishlist): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4953280
Website: https://norytestudios.com
Press kit: https://norytestudios.com/groovekeeper/press

Made by Noryte Studios. Subscribe to follow Groovekeeper and everything we make next.
